A wedding highlight video (or Wedding Highlight Reel) is a short video that combines the most important moments of a wedding into "Highlights" or "Highlights" of the entire event, carefully selected and edited.

A wedding highlight video is a collection of the best scenes from a wedding day into a short 3-5 minute video. It condenses the excitement and enjoyment of a wedding with an image similar to a movie trailer.
The most popular wedding video is the "highlight video." This short video of the best scenes from a wedding day is perfect for sharing on social media and for later playback.
When sending videos to guests at a wedding, long videos have a large file size and are difficult to send and view. Highlight videos can be easily shared via email or messaging app.
